About.title: Canine & Feline Passion, European Excellence
About.subtitle: pawelium was born from Théodore de Parin's passion for purebred animals. With 6 years of experience, he connects families with the finest certified dog and cat breeders in Europe.
About.founderP1: Passionate about breeding since childhood, Théodore founded pawelium in 2018 with a simple goal: helping families find their ideal companion — dog or cat — with serious, certified breeders.
About.founderP2: His network now covers five European countries (France, Belgium, Germany, the Netherlands, Spain) and exclusively includes breeding facilities affiliated with the FCI/LOF for dogs and the LOOF for cats, or their equivalent national registries (VDH, LOSH…).

timeline.t2018Desc: Launch of the canine selection activity in Paris, with an initial selection of Golden Retrievers and French Bulldogs.
timeline.t2020Desc: Network extension to partner breeders in Belgium, Germany and the Netherlands. First collaboration with FCI-certified breeders.
timeline.t2022Desc: Opening up to feline breeders (LOOF) and deepening expertise in animal health and vaccination protocols. Strengthened partnerships with European veterinarians.
timeline.t2024Desc: Launch of pawelium.fyi, a premium digital showcase to present the finest purebred puppies and kittens from our European network.

values.selectionDesc: Every dog presented is selected according to strict FCI/LOF health, temperament and lineage criteria.
values.welfareDesc: Our partner breeders comply with European animal welfare standards and WSAVA guidelines.
values.transparencyDesc: All information — health, pedigree, vaccination, lineage — is presented clearly and unambiguously.
values.supportDesc: Direct WhatsApp contact to answer all your questions, before and after the acquisition.

About.ctaSubtitle: Contact Théodore directly via WhatsApp. He will guide you in finding your ideal companion.
